description.narrative: The Youth Leader Exchange (YLE) will be attached to the ongoing pilot project entitled the Zambia Adolescent Girls Advocacy (ZAMGA). The YLE aims to strengthen and support the partnership between the DUF member organisation and the partner organisation, and to evaluate and assess the outcome of the ZAMGA project, support and strengthen the partnership between FUN and TLF, develop ideas on how to help motivate volunteerism amongst youths and locals as part of a strategic effort to strengthen advocacy. Two full time Danish youth Leaders, and four Zambian youth leaders will be applying for the YLE, which will run for two months, from the 10.09.22 to 10.11.22. The youth leaders will benefit from the project and the partnership by gaining necessary and relevant experience and skill sets in leadership, civic engagement as well as organisatory skills as they will directly be involved in participating and arranging a number of youth development activities.
